page_title: VIL 4-2 SEV | Villarreal v Sevilla 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The match has just finished.
90+2' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

89' This was a nice set play except the finish. Unmarked Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) controlled a precise lofted pass from the corner kick far out and unleashed a long-range shot. He didn't hit the ball exactly how he'd wanted and it went within inches of the left post.
89' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.

89' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) coming on for Suso.
86' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

85' 4 - 2 Lucien Agoume produces a killer pass to release Ramon Martinez (Sevilla), who then unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 4:2!
84' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Suso (Sevilla) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
82' Peque (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola signals a set piece.
81' Denis Suarez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Daniel Requena (Villarreal).
77' A cooling break is underway.
76' Suso (Sevilla) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
76' A pass into the box finds Thierno Barry (Villarreal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alvaro Fernandez denies him.
75' Pape Gueye will be replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
75' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Etta Eyong (Villarreal) replaces Tajon Buchanan.
74' Suso (Sevilla) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
74' Here's the change. Juanlu Sanchez leaves the pitch and Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.

73' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Diego Conde was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

69' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
68' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Diego Conde is equal to it and makes an easy save.
66' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:2.
63' Joaquin Caparros Camino prepares a substitution. Alvaro Pascual is replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ramon Martinez (Sevilla) is coming onto the pitch as Jose Angel Carmona cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
60' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
57' Marcelino has decided to substitute Alex Baena and he is replaced by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal).
56' Today's match ends for Yeremy Pino who will be replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
53' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Thierno Barry tees up Pape Gueye (Villarreal) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Alvaro Fernandez.
52' Crossbar! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
52' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

52' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
50' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
48' The game is interrupted as Suso (Sevilla) is flagged offside.
47' Fine attempt! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
46' Joaquin Caparros Camino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) comes on the pitch for Djibril Sow.
46' Javier Alberola blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' So close! Suso (Sevilla) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
45+3' Suso (Sevilla) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
45+3' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
45+2' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sevilla are going to take it.
45+2' The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
42' A lofted cross from Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
41' Great chance! Denis Suarez (Villarreal) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar.

39' 3 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Alex Baena (Villarreal) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 3:1. Alvaro Fernandez was helpless.
37' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Fernandez intercepts the ball.
35' The foul by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) was seen by Javier Alberola who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
32' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
31' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.

29' 2 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Suso finds Djibril Sow (Sevilla), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Diego Conde had no chance of stopping that. 2:1.
28' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
26' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
24' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Some patient build-up play from Villarreal as they look to unlock the defence.
19' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
18' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
17' A pass from Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is intercepted by Alvaro Fernandez and the move breaks down.
16' Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
14' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

14' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper. It will be a corner kick for Villarreal.
14' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner.
14' A cross from Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Villarreal.
12' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
8' 2 - 0 Goal! Great play by Tajon Buchanan releases Pape Gueye (Villarreal) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 2:0.
7' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 1:0.
3' Sevilla are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' Logan Costa (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola will referee today's match.
